title: Catalyst Surf Shop
includes: Surfboards physically available at one of five retail locations
gap: No physical address or phone number stated
blurb: Catalyst Surf Shop sells surfboards and related products available online and in five physical stores. They offer shipping within the continental U.S., Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico, Canada, and internationally with various flat rates depending on surfboard size and destination. Customers can pick up surfboards in-store at the location where the board is physically available.
extraNote: Free domestic shipping on orders over $75 within Continental U.S. · Flat shipping fee $6.99 for orders under $75 within Continental U.S. · Surfboard shipping fees vary by size and destination, e.g. $75 for surfboards 5'8 and shorter in Continental U.S. · Customer responsible for all duties, customs, and taxes on international orders.
